# 044 · Payments recording and matching

- **outcome** Payments can be recorded and listed (payments record/list); payments with a reference to a finalized invoice of the same tenant and currency are matched, invoices get open amount (gross - payments - credit notes) and paid flag, shown in invoices show. 8 new tests, suite at 428. ## Tried
- `2026-11-11` DECISION: Payments (meterbill/payments/, data/payments.jsonl, one JSON payment per line, appended under a lock; CLI 'payments record --tenant --amount --currency --date [--reference]' and 'payments list --tenant [--unmatched]'). A payment matches an invoice only if reference == invoice number AND invoice is finalized AND same tenant AND same currency; otherwise it stays unmatched. Matching is derived on every read from stored payments; nothing is written back to the invoice or the payment. open amount = gross - matched payments - credit notes; paid flag when open <= 0 (overpayment = negative open, counts as paid). Credit notes are read from <data-dir>/documents/*.json (only place they live; missing dir = none). Recording rejects non-positive amounts, empty references and tenant ids not in tenants.json.
